The aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 is running (`backfill-2026-11-12`, started 08:57 UTC), at 61% at the last check, with 14.9M rows in ClickHouse `events_v3` for the incident window against ~20.5M expected. - [décision] The incident stays open until the counts match (source: r2-07)

- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never produce to `events.v3` directly from this tool (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
